verses.geez:
ወግዕዙ ፡ እምኤ[ሌም] ፡ ወመጽኡ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገዳም ፡ ዘሲ[ን] ፡ ወውእቱ ፡ ማእከለ ፡
                  ኤ[ሌ]ም ፡ ወሲና ፡ አመ ፡ ዐሡር ፡ ወኀሙስ ፡ ዕለት ፡ ለካልእ ፡ ወርኅ ፡ [እምዘ ፡] ወፅኡ ፡ እምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ።
verses.translation: And they departed from Ælim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Ælim and Sina; and on the fifteenth day, in the second month after their departure from the land of Egypt,

translations.lxx: And they departed from Ælim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Ælim and Sina; and on the fifteenth day, in the second month after their departure from the land of Egypt,
translations.kjv: And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.
translations.ron: Plecând apoi din Elim, a venit toată obştea fiilor lui Israel în pustia Sin, câre este între Elim şi între Sinai, în ziua a cincisprezecea a lunii a doua, după ieşirea din Egipt.

verses.geez: ወአንጐርጐረ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ውሉደ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ በላዕለ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወአሮን ።
verses.translation: all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron.

translations.lxx: all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron.
translations.kjv: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness:
translations.ron: În pustia aceasta toată obştea fiilor lui Israel a cârtit împotriva lui Moise şi Aaron.

verses.geez:
ወይቤልዎሙ ፡ ውሉደ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ሶበ ፡ ሞትነ ፡ በመቅሠፍተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ አመ ፡ ንነብር ፡
                  ጠቃ ፡ ጸሀርት ፡ ዘሥጋ ፡ ወንበልዕ ፡ ኅብስተ ፡ እስከ ፡ ንጸግብ ፤ አምጻእከነ ፡ አንተ ፡ ውስተዝ ፡ ገዳም ፡ ከመ ፡
                  ትቅትል ፡ ኵለነ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ተጋባእነ ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel said to them, Would we had died smitten by the Lord in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh-pots, and ate bread to satiety! for ye have brought us out into this wilderness, to slay all this congregation with hunger.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel said to them, Would we had died smitten by the Lord in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh-pots, and ate bread to satiety! for ye have brought us out into this wilderness, to slay all this congregation with hunger.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel said unto them, Would to God we had died by the hand of the LORD in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots, and when we did eat bread to the full; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.
translations.ron: Şi au zis către ei fiii lui Israel: "Mai bine muream bătuţi de Domnul în pământul Egiptului, când şedeam împrejurul căldărilor cu carne şi mâncam pâine de ne săturam! Dar voi ne-aţi adus în pustia aceasta, ca toată obştea aceasta să moară de foame".

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ናሁ ፡ አነ ፡ ኣወርድ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ ኅብስተ ፡ እምሰማይ ፡ ወይምጻእ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡
                  ወያስተጋብእ ፡ ለለ ፡ ዕለት ፡ ከመ ፡ አመክሮሙ ፡ ለእመ ፡ የሐውሩ ፡ በሕግየ ፡ ወእመ ፡ አልቦ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Behold, I will rain bread upon you out of heaven: and the people shall go forth, and they shall gather their daily portion for the day, that I may try them whether they will walk in my law or not.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to Moses, Behold, I will rain bread upon you out of heaven: and the people shall go forth, and they shall gather their daily portion for the day, that I may try them whether they will walk in my law or not.
translations.kjv: Then said the LORD unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.
translations.ron: Domnul însă a zis către Moise: "Iată Eu le voi ploua pâine din cer. Să iasă dar poporul şi să adune în fiecare zi cât trebuie pentru o zi, ca să-l încerc dacă va umbla sau nu după legea Mea.

verses.geez:
ወአመ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ዐርብ ፡ ያስተዳልዉ ፡ ዘአብኡ ፡ ይኩኖሙ ፡ ካዕበተ ፡ ለለዕለት ፡ ወዘአስተጋብ[ኡ ፡] ዘልፈ ፡
                  ለለዕለቱ ።
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass on the sixth day that they shall prepare whatsoever they have brought in, and it shall be double of what they shall have gathered for the day, daily.

translations.lxx: And it shall come to pass on the sixth day that they shall prepare whatsoever they have brought in, and it shall be double of what they shall have gathered for the day, daily.
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare that which they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.
translations.ron: Iar în ziua a şasea să adune de două ori mai mult decât adunau în celelalte zile, pentru o zi".

verses.geez:
ወይቤሉ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወአሮን ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እምሰርክ ፡ ታአምሩ ፡ ከመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አውፅአክሙ ፡
                  እምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ።
verses.translation: And Moses and Aaron said to all the congregation of the children of Israel, At even ye shall know that the Lord has brought you out of the land of Egypt;

translations.lxx: And Moses and Aaron said to all the congregation of the children of Israel, At even ye shall know that the Lord has brought you out of the land of Egypt;
translations.kjv: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel, At even, then ye shall know that the LORD hath brought you out from the land of Egypt:
translations.ron: Atunci au zis Moise şi Aaron către toată adunarea fiilor lui Israel: "Diseară veţi cunoaşte că Domnul v-a scos din pământul Egiptului.

verses.geez:
ወነግህ ፡ ትሬእዩ ፡ ኀይለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሰሚዖ ፡ ነጐርጓረክሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወንሕነ ፡ ምንት ፡ ንሕነ ፡
                  ዘታንጐረጕሩ ፡ በላዕሌነ ።
verses.translation: and in the morning ye shall see the glory of the Lord, inasmuch as he hears your murmuring against God; and who are we, that ye continue to murmur against us?

translations.lxx: and in the morning ye shall see the glory of the Lord, inasmuch as he hears your murmuring against God; and who are we, that ye continue to murmur against us?
translations.kjv: And in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of the LORD; for that he heareth your murmurings against the LORD: and what are we, that ye murmur against us?
translations.ron: Şi dimineaţă veţi vedea slava Domnului, că El a auzit cârtirea voastră împotriva lui Dumnezeu; iar noi ce suntem de cârtiţi împotriva noastră?"

verses.geez:
ወይቤ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ሰርከ ፡ ይሁበክሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሥጋ ፡ ትብልዑ ፡ ወነግህ ፡ ኅብስተ ፡ እስከ ፡ ትጸግቡ ፡ እስመ ፡
                  ሰምዐ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ነጐርጓረክሙ ፡ ነጐርጓር ፡ ዘታንጐረጕሩ ፡ አንትሙ ፡ በላዕሌነ ፡ ወንሕነ ፡ ምንት ፡ ንሕነ ፡ ወዝ ፡
                  ነጐርጓርክሙ ፡ አኮ ፡ በላዕሌነ ፡ ዘታንጐረጕሩ ፡ [አላ ፡ በ]ላዕለ ፡ ፈጣሪ ።
verses.translation: And Moses said, This shall be when the Lord gives you in the evening flesh to eat, and bread in the morning to satiety, because the Lord has heard your murmuring, which ye murmur against us: and what are we? for your murmuring is not against us, but against God.

translations.lxx: And Moses said, This shall be when the Lord gives you in the evening flesh to eat, and bread in the morning to satiety, because the Lord has heard your murmuring, which ye murmur against us: and what are we? for your murmuring is not against us, but against God.
translations.kjv: And Moses said, This shall be, when the LORD shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that the LORD heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him: and what are we? your murmurings are not against us, but against the LORD.
translations.ron: Şi a mai zis Moise: "Când Domnul vă va da diseară carne să mâncaţi şi dimineaţă pâine să vă săturaţi, din aceea veri afla că a auzit Domnul cârtirea ce aţi ridicat asupra Lui. Căci noi ce suntem? Cârtirea voastră nu este împotriva noastră, ci împotriva lui Dumnezeu".

verses.geez:
ወይቤ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ በል ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ተጋብኡ ፡ ውሉደ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ቅረቡ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ፈጣሪ ፡ እስመ ፡
                  ሰምዐ ፡ ነጐርጓረክሙ ።
verses.translation: And Moses said to Aaron, Say to all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before God; for he has heard your murmuring.

translations.lxx: And Moses said to Aaron, Say to all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before God; for he has heard your murmuring.
translations.kjv: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the LORD: for he hath heard your murmurings.
translations.ron: Apoi a zis Moise către Aaron: "Spune la toată adunarea fiilor lui Israel: Apropiaţi-vă înaintea lui Dumnezeu, că a auzit cârtirea voastră!"

verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ይትናገር ፡ አሮን ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ተጋብኡ ፡ ውሉደ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወተመይጡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገዳም ፡ ወሠርሐ ፡
                  እግዚአብሔር ፡ ተርእ[የ ፡] በደመና ።
verses.translation: And when Aaron spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they turned toward the wilderness, then the glory of the Lord appeared in a cloud.

translations.lxx: And when Aaron spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they turned toward the wilderness, then the glory of the Lord appeared in a cloud.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of the LORD appeared in the cloud.
translations.ron: Iar când vorbea Aaron către toată adunarea fiilor lui Israel, au căutat ei spre pustie şi iată slava Domnului s-a arătat în nor.

verses.geez: ወይቤ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
translations.ron: Şi a grăit Domnul cu Moise şi a zis:

verses.geez:
ሰማዕኩ ፡ ነጐርጓሮሙ ፡ ለውሉደ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወበሎሙ ፡ ሰርከ ፡ ትበልዑ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ ወጸቢሖ ፡ ትጸግቡ ፡ ኅብስተ ፡
                  ወታአምሩ ፡ ከመ ፡ አነ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ፈጣሬ ፡ ዚአክሙ ።
verses.translation: I have heard the murmuring of the children of Israel: speak to them, saying, Towards evening ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be satisfied with bread; and ye shall know that I am the Lord your God.

translations.lxx: I have heard the murmuring of the children of Israel: speak to them, saying, Towards evening ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be satisfied with bread; and ye shall know that I am the Lord your God.
translations.kjv: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel: speak unto them, saying, At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread; and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God.
translations.ron: "Am auzit cârtirea fiilor lui Israel. Spune-le dar: Diseară carne veţi mânca, iar dimineaţă vă veţi sătura de pâine şi veţi cunoaşte că Eu, Domnul, sunt Dumnezeul vostru".

verses.geez:
ወመስየ ፡ ወመጽአ ፡ ፍርፍርት ፡ ወከደነ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ትዕይንቶሙ ፡ ወነግሀ ፡ እንዘ ፡ የኀድግ ፡ ህቦ ፡ በኵርጓኔ ፡
                  ትዕይንቶሙ ፤
verses.translation: And it was evening, and quails came up and covered the camp:

translations.lxx: And it was evening, and quails came up and covered the camp:
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host.
translations.ron: Iar, dacă s-a făcut seară, au venit prepeliţe şi au acoperit tabăra, iar dimineaţa, după ce s-a luat roua dimprejurul taberei,

verses.geez: እምፍጽመ ፡ ገዳም ፡ ድቁቅ ፡ ከመ ፡ ተቅዳ ፡ ወጸዐዳ ፡ ከመ ፡ አስሐትያ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.translation: in the morning it came to pass as the dew ceased round about the camp, that, behold, on the face of the wilderness was a small thing like white coriander seed, as frost upon the earth.

translations.lxx: in the morning it came to pass as the dew ceased round about the camp, that, behold, on the face of the wilderness was a small thing like white coriander seed, as frost upon the earth.
translations.kjv: And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness there lay a small round thing, as small as the hoar frost on the ground.
translations.ron: Iată, se afla pe faţa pustiei ceva mărunt, ca nişte grăunţe, şi albicios, ca grindina pe pământ.

verses.geez:
ወርእዩ ፡ ውሉደ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ለካልኡ ፡ ምንት ፡ ውእቱዝ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኢያአምሩ ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡
                  ዝውእቱ ፡ ኅብስት ፡ ዘወሀበክሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ትብልዑ ።
verses.translation: And when the children of Israel saw it, they said one to another, What is this? for they knew not what it was; and Moses said to them,

translations.lxx: And when the children of Israel saw it, they said one to another, What is this? for they knew not what it was; and Moses said to them,
translations.kjv: And when the children of Israel saw it, they said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was. And Moses said unto them, This is the bread which the LORD hath given you to eat.
translations.ron: Şi văzând fiii lui Israel, au zis unii către alţii: "Ce e asta?" Că nu ştiau ce e. Iar Moise le-a zis: "Aceasta e pâinea pe care v-o dă Dumnezeu să o mâncaţi.

verses.geez:
ዝውእቱ ፡ ቃል ፡ ዘይቤ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አስተጋብኡ ፡ እምውስቴቱ ፡ በንዋይክሙ ፡ ለለ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ በበ ፡ ኍልቈ ፡
                  ሰብኡ ፡ ለለርእሱ ፡ በንዋዩ ፡ ለያስተጋብእ ።
verses.translation: This is the bread which the Lord has given you to eat. This is that which the Lord has appointed: gather of it each man for his family, a homer for each person, according to the number of your souls, gather each of you with his fellow-lodgers.

translations.lxx: This is the bread which the Lord has given you to eat. This is that which the Lord has appointed: gather of it each man for his family, a homer for each person, according to the number of your souls, gather each of you with his fellow-lodgers.
translations.kjv: This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, Gather of it every man according to his eating, an omer for every man, according to the number of your persons; take ye every man for them which are in his tents.
translations.ron: Iată ce a poruncit Domnul: Adunaţi fiecare cât să vă ajungă de mâncat; câte un omer de om, după numărul sufletelor voastre; fiecare câţi are în cort, atâtea omere să adune!"

verses.geez: ወገብሩ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ውሉደ ፡ እስራኤል ፤ አስተጋብኡ ፡ ዘብዙኅኒ ፡ ወዘሕዳጥኒ ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel did so, and gathered some much and some less.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel did so, and gathered some much and some less.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel did so, and gathered, some more, some less.
translations.ron: Şi au făcut aşa fiii lui Israel; au adunat unii mai mult, alţii mai puţin;

verses.geez:
ወሰፈሩ ፡ በጎሞር ፡ ወኢፈድፈደ ፡ ለዘ ፡ ብዙኀ ፡ አስተጋብአ ፡ ወኢኀጸጸ ፡ ለዘ ፡ ኅዳጠ ፡ አስተጋብአ ፤ ብእሲ ፡
                  ብእሲ ፡ ለለማኅደሩ ፡ አስቲጋብአ ።
verses.translation: And having measured the homer full, he that had gathered much had nothing over, and he that had gathered less had no lack; each gathered according to the need of those who belonged to him.

translations.lxx: And having measured the homer full, he that had gathered much had nothing over, and he that had gathered less had no lack; each gathered according to the need of those who belonged to him.
translations.kjv: And when they did mete it with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack; they gathered every man according to his eating.
translations.ron: Dar măsurând cu omerul, nici celui ce adunase mult n-a prisosit, nici celui ce adunase puţin n-a lipsit, ci fiecare, cât era deajuns la cei ce erau cu sine, atât a adunat.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወኢታትርፉ ፡ ለጌሠም ።
verses.translation: And Moses said to them, Let no man leave of it till the morning.

translations.lxx: And Moses said to them, Let no man leave of it till the morning.
translations.kjv: And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.
translations.ron: Zis-a iarăşi Moise către ei: "Nimeni să nu lase din aceasta pe a doua zi".

verses.geez: ወኢሰምዕዎ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወአቤቱ ፡ ለነግህ ፡ ወዐጽየ ፡ ወጼአ ፡ ወተምዐ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ በላዕሌሆሙ ።
verses.translation: But they did not hearken to Moses, but some left of it till the morning; and it bred worms and stank: and Moses was irritated with them.

translations.lxx: But they did not hearken to Moses, but some left of it till the morning; and it bred worms and stank: and Moses was irritated with them.
translations.kjv: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses was wroth with them.
translations.ron: Dar ei n-au ascultat pe Moise, ci unii au lăsat din aceasta pe a doua zi; dar a făcut viermi şi s-a stricat. Şi s-a mâniat pe ei Moise.

verses.geez: ወአስተጋብኡ ፡ በበነግህ ፡ ለለርእሱ ፡ ወእምከመ ፡ ሞቀ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ ይምሁ ።
verses.translation: And they gathered it every morning, each man what he needed, and when the sun waxed hot it melted.

translations.lxx: And they gathered it every morning, each man what he needed, and when the sun waxed hot it melted.
translations.kjv: And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.
translations.ron: Fiecare aduna mană dimineaţa cât îi trebuia pentru mâncat în ziua aceea, căci, dacă se înfierbânta soarele, ceea ce rămânea se topea.

verses.geez:
ወበዕለተ ፡ ዐርብ ፡ ያስተጋብኡ ፡ ካዕበተ ፡ ጎሞር ፡ ለለአሐዱ ፡ ወቦአ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ መኳንንተ ፡ ማኅበር ፡ ወይቤልዎ ፡
                  ለሙሴ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the sixth day, they gathered double what was needed, two homers for one man; and all the chiefs of the synagogue went in and reported it to Moses.

translations.lxx: And it came to pass on the sixth day, they gathered double what was needed, two homers for one man; and all the chiefs of the synagogue went in and reported it to Moses.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one man: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.
translations.ron: Iar în ziua a şasea adunară de două ori mai multă: câte două omere de fiecare. Şi au venit toate căpeteniile adunării să-l înştiinţeze pe Moise.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ዝውእቱ ፡ ዘይቤሎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ሰንበተ ፡ ዕረፍት ፡ ወቡርክት ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ጌሠመ ፤ ዘትግበሩ ፡
                  ሀለወክሙ ፡ ግበሩ ፤ ወዘታብስሉ ፡ ሀለወክሙ ፡ አብስሉ ፤ ወዘተርፈ ፡ አትርፉ ።
verses.translation: And Moses said to them, Is not this the word which the Lord spoke? To-morrow is the sabbath, a holy rest to the Lord: bake that ye will bake, and seethe that ye will seethe, and all that is over leave to be laid by for the morrow.

translations.lxx: And Moses said to them, Is not this the word which the Lord spoke? To-morrow is the sabbath, a holy rest to the Lord: bake that ye will bake, and seethe that ye will seethe, and all that is over leave to be laid by for the morrow.
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, This is that which the LORD hath said, To morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath unto the LORD: bake that which ye will bake to day, and seethe that ye will seethe; and that which remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning.
translations.ron: Iar Moise le-a zis: "Iată ce a zis Domnul: Mâine e odihnă, odihna cea sfântă în cinstea Domnului; ce trebuie copt coaceţi, ce trebuie fiert, fierbeţi astăzi, şi ce va rămâne, păstraţi pe a doua zi!"

verses.geez: ወአትረፉ ፡ ለነግህ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዘ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወኢጼአ ፡ ወዕጼሂ ፡ ኢተፈጥረ ፡ በላዕሌሁ ።
verses.translation: And they left of it till the morning, as Moses commanded them; and it stank not, neither was there a worm in it.

translations.lxx: And they left of it till the morning, as Moses commanded them; and it stank not, neither was there a worm in it.
translations.kjv: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did not stink, neither was there any worm therein.
translations.ron: Şi au lăsat din acestea până dimineaţa, după cum le poruncise Moise, şi nu s-au stricat nici n-au făcut viermi.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ብልዑ ፡ ዮም ፡ እስመ ፡ ዮም ፡ ሰንበት ፡ ዘእግዚአብሔር ፡ ኢትረክቡ ፡ በገዳም ።
verses.translation: And Moses said, Eat that to-day, for to-day is a sabbath to the Lord: it shall not be found in the plain.

translations.lxx: And Moses said, Eat that to-day, for to-day is a sabbath to the Lord: it shall not be found in the plain.
translations.kjv: And Moses said, Eat that to day; for to day is a sabbath unto the LORD: to day ye shall not find it in the field.
translations.ron: Apoi a zis Moise: "Mâncaţi aceasta astăzi, că astăzi este odihna în cinstea Domnului şi nu veţi găsi de aceasta astăzi pe câmp.

verses.geez: ሰዱሰ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ታስተጋብኡ ፡ ወአመ ፡ ሳብዕት ፡ ዕለት ፡ ሰንበት ፡ አሜሃ ፡ ኢትረክቡ ።
verses.translation: Six days ye shall gather it, and on the seventh day is a sabbath, for there shall be none on that day.

translations.lxx: Six days ye shall gather it, and on the seventh day is a sabbath, for there shall be none on that day.
translations.kjv: Six days ye shall gather it; but on the seventh day, which is the sabbath, in it there shall be none.
translations.ron: Şase zile să adunaţi, iar ziua a şaptea este zi de odihnă şi nu veţi afla din ea în această zi".

verses.geez: ወአመ ፡ ሳብዕት ፡ ዕለት ፡ ቦዘወፅአ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያስተጋብእ ፡ ወኢረከበ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the seventh day that some of the people went forth to gather, and found none.

translations.lxx: And it came to pass on the seventh day that some of the people went forth to gather, and found none.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that there went out some of the people on the seventh day for to gather, and they found none.
translations.ron: Dar unii din popor au ieşit să adune şi în ziua a şaptea şi n-au găsit.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ እስከ ፡ ማእዜ ፡ ተአብዩ ፡ ትእዛዝየ ፡ ሰሚዐ ፡ ወሕግየ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to Moses, How long are ye unwilling to hearken to my commands and my law?

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to Moses, How long are ye unwilling to hearken to my commands and my law?
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?
translations.ron: Atunci Domnul a zis către Moise: "Până când nu veţi voi să ascultaţi de poruncile Mele şi de învăţăturile Mele?

verses.geez:
ርእዩ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወሀበክሙ ፡ ዘዕለተ ፡ ሰንበት ፡ በእንተዝ ፡ ወሀበክሙ ፡ በዕለተ ፡ ዐርብ ፡ ምሳሐ ፡ ለክልኤ ፡
                  ዕለት ፡ ወይንበር ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ማኅደሩ ፡ ወኢይፃእ ፡ እምንባሪሁ ፡ አመ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ሰንበት ።
verses.translation: See, for the Lord has given you this day as the sabbath, therefore he has given you on the sixth day the bread of two days: ye shall sit each of you in your houses; let no one go forth from his place on the seventh day.

translations.lxx: See, for the Lord has given you this day as the sabbath, therefore he has given you on the sixth day the bread of two days: ye shall sit each of you in your houses; let no one go forth from his place on the seventh day.
translations.kjv: See, for that the LORD hath given you the sabbath, therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide ye every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.
translations.ron: Vedeţi că Domnul v-a dat ziua aceasta de odihnă şi de aceea vă dă El în ziua a şasea şi pâine pentru două zile; rămâneţi fiecare în casele voastre şi nimeni să nu iasă de la locul său în ziua a şaptea".

verses.geez: ወአሰንበተ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ በዕለተ ፡ ሰንበት ።
verses.translation: And the people kept sabbath on the seventh day.

translations.lxx: And the people kept sabbath on the seventh day.
translations.kjv: So the people rested on the seventh day.
translations.ron: Şi s-a odihnit poporul în ziua a şaptea.

verses.geez: ወሰመይዎ ፡ ውሉደ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ መና ፡ ወከመ ፡ ፍሬ ፡ ተቅዳ ፡ ጸዐዳ ፡ ወጣዕሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢያተ ፡ መዓር ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel called the name of it Man; and it was as white coriander seed, and the taste of it as a wafer with honey.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel called the name of it Man; and it was as white coriander seed, and the taste of it as a wafer with honey.
translations.kjv: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.
translations.ron: Casa lui Israel i-a pus numele mană şi aceasta era albă, ca sămânţa de coriandru, iar la gust ca turta cu miere.

verses.geez:
ወይቤ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ዝቃል ፡ ዘአዘዘ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ትምልኡ ፡ ጎሞር ፡ መና ፡ ውስተ ፡ መሣይምቲክሙ ፡ ለዘመድክሙ
                  ፡ ከመ ፡ ይርአዩ ፡ ኅብስተ ፡ ዘበላዕክሙ ፡ አንትሙ ፡ በገዳም ፡ አመ ፡ አውፅአክሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ።
verses.translation: And Moses said, This is the thing which the Lord hath commanded, Fill an homer with manna, to be laid up for your generations; that they may see the bread which ye ate in the wilderness, when the Lord led you forth out of the land of Egypt.

translations.lxx: And Moses said, This is the thing which the Lord hath commanded, Fill an homer with manna, to be laid up for your generations; that they may see the bread which ye ate in the wilderness, when the Lord led you forth out of the land of Egypt.
translations.kjv: And Moses said, This is the thing which the LORD commandeth, Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations; that they may see the bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.
translations.ron: După aceea Moise a zis: "Iată ce porunceşte Domnul: Umpleţi cu mană un omer, ca să se păstreze în viitor urmaşilor voştri, ca să vadă pâinea cu care v-am hrănit Eu în pustie, după ce v-am scos din ţara Egiptului".

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ንሣእ ፡ ቈጽለ ፡ ወርቅ ፡ አሐተ ፡ ረቃቀ ፡ ወግሉ ፡ ባቲ ፡ ጎሞር ፡ ዘመና ፡ ወታነብራ ፡
                  ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለደኃሪ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ ለአዝማዲክሙ ።
verses.translation: And Moses said to Aaron, Take a golden pot, and cast into it one full homer of manna; and thou shalt lay it up before God, to be kept for your generations,

translations.lxx: And Moses said to Aaron, Take a golden pot, and cast into it one full homer of manna; and thou shalt lay it up before God, to be kept for your generations,
translations.kjv: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept for your generations.
translations.ron: Iar către Aaron a zis Moise: "Ia un vas de aur şi toarnă în el un omer plin cu mană şi pune-l înaintea Domnului, ca să se păstreze în viitor pentru urmaşii voştri!"

verses.geez: እስመ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ [ወአንበሮ ፡ አሮን ፡] በቅድመ ፡ መርጡል ፡ ከመ ፡ ይትዐቀብ ።
verses.translation: as the Lord commanded Moses: and Aaron laid it up before the testimony to be kept.

translations.lxx: as the Lord commanded Moses: and Aaron laid it up before the testimony to be kept.
translations.kjv: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
translations.ron: Şi l-a pus Aaron înaintea chivotului mărturiei, ca să se păstreze, cum poruncise Domnul lui Moise.

verses.geez:
[ወ]ውሉደ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ በልዑ ፡ መና ፡ ፴ክረምተ ፡ እስከ ፡ ይበጽሑ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ያነብሮሙ ፡ በልዑ ፡ መና ፡
                  እስከ ፡ ይበጽሑ ፡ ደወለ ፡ ፊኒቅ ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel ate manna forty years, until they came to the land they ate the manna, until they came to the region of Phœnicia.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel ate manna forty years, until they came to the land they ate the manna, until they came to the region of Phœnicia.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited; they did eat manna, until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan.
translations.ron: Iar fiii lui Israel au mâncat mană patruzeci de ani, până ce au ajuns în tară locuită; până ce au ajuns în hotarele pământului Canaan au mâncat mană.

verses.geez: ወጎሞር ፡ ዐሠርቱ ፡ እድ ፡ ዘ፫መስፈርት ፡ ይእቲ ።
verses.translation: Now the homer was the tenth part of three measures.

translations.lxx: Now the homer was the tenth part of three measures.
translations.kjv: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.
translations.ron: Iar omerul este a zecea parte dintr-o efă.
